title: The Nawab Flees and Charat Singh Grows in Strength

blocks.text: The siege unravels when reports spread that a larger Sikh host is approaching the field. Faced with warnings of an approaching Khalsa force, the Nawab loses nerve, and the cohesion of his camp begins to dissolve before the feared reinforcement even fully arrives.

Night flight, confusion, and opportunistic looting follow. The same encirclement meant to crush Charat Singh instead enriches him, raises his standing, and helps extend Sikh influence across a wider northern belt.

By the end of the page, the episode has shifted from siege survival to strategic expansion. Charat Singh emerges not merely as a defender of Gujranwala but as a chief whose success now draws wealth, fame, and new territory.
